data.title: 菲奥娜 · 雨夜公用电话亭暗号接头
data.description: 【菲奥娜 · 雨夜公用电话亭暗号接头】冷雨绵绵的柏林特深夜街头，深蓝双排扣大衣下包裹着挺拔冷艳的身姿。菲奥娜一手收拢黑伞靠在玻璃门侧，一手握住泛着微温的黑色听筒。电话亭顶灯昏黄的暖光穿透雨水滑落的玻璃壁，描摹出她冷若冰霜的侧颜与被右侧长刘海遮住半边的脸。在毫无波澜的语调下，西国代号「夜帷」的密文准确无误地传出。
data.location: 雨夜柏林特街头电话亭
data.action: 一手将收拢黑伞靠在玻璃门侧，一手握黑色听筒汇报密电。
data.lighting: 电话亭昏黄暖光与湿漉雨夜反光
data.promptProse: Inside a glowing glass telephone booth on a rain-slicked Berlint boulevard at night, Fiona Frost holds a black telephone receiver to her ear while her other hand steadies a closed black umbrella against the glass door. Her dark-blue WISE pea coat and purple turtleneck remain buttoned against the cold. Yellow booth lamplight outlines her blunt white bob and long right-side fringe as she calmly reports a coded message, watching the empty street through rain-streaked glass. Wet cobblestone reflections and heavy establish the nocturnal espionage setting.
